correctness.rationale: The line-graph identification is exact. In this diameter-two graph, general-position sets are precisely induced disjoint unions of cliques. That gives \(\operatorname{gp}=n+1\), with the \(n=2\) maximum triangles handled separately. Every size-\(n+1\) set is frozen, while the explicit reversible excursions from \(\{x,b_1,\ldots,b_{n-1}\}\) visit every vertex with \(n\) robots. A fresh exhaustive state-space check for \(n=2,3,4,5\) corroborated both values; the all-\(n\) proof is structural.
